fires energy beams at enemies. This deals damage to a single enemy, while also knocking it back at later levels. There is a 3 second cooldown before an enemy can be knocked back again.
The second red range ring is the melee range. In it, the

will attack enemies with its sword. This will deal AOE damage, with the intended target receiving both the melee and ranged damage, while anything hit alongside it only receives the ranged damage. This also applies bleed to enemies. If there are enemies in both its ranged and melee ranges, it will prioritize attacking enemies in its melee range.

At Level 4, it gains the ability to apply bleed to enemies. Each bleed applied will only deal damage to an enemy once before disappearing, with there also being a 1.8 second delay between each bleed damage. Additionally, it can only deal damage while bleed is not being applied. This bleed can stack up to 40 times, which will cause a bleed collapse, dealing increased damage to the enemy instantly. AOE Damage is damage dealt to both the targeted enemies and any additional enemies, with the number being based on the
max hits. The damage is the same as the melee attack's damage.
DPS is calculated as (Damage + AOE Damage) ÷ Swingrate. DPS does not include bleed damage.
Max DPS is calculated as (Damage + AOE Damage x Max Hits) ÷ Swingrate. Max DPS does not include bleed damage.
